title: Fermionic Villain model with exact lattice chiral symmetries
summary: We present a fermionic lattice Hamiltonian that exactly realizes the $\mathrm{U(1)}_\mathrm{L}\times \mathrm{U(1)}_\mathrm{R}$ global symmetry and the associated chiral anomalies of a massless Dirac fermion in 1+1 dimensions. The construction couples Villain bosons to a Kitaev chain of Majorana fermions, where the bosonic fields are essential for evading Nielsen-Ninomiya-type no-go theorems.
